hero.title: The 12 Houses
hero.subtitle: The houses divide your birth chart into twelve sectors, each governing a specific area of life. Where the planets fall in your chart tells the story of how their energy plays out in your world.

method_note: House system: Equal House (each house spans exactly 30°, beginning from the Ascendant). The birth chart calculator on Spellful uses Equal House division.
cta_body: Enter your birth date, time, and location to discover which planets occupy each house in your personal chart.
